verdicts.reason: I scored both 2 out of 5. Both drop the Solstice logo and the dark brand header. Both also shrink the body copy and legal text to an unreadable size in the tiny banner, and in both the legal text is nearly as prominent as the body copy. A keeps the orange 'Limited Summer Release' eyebrow and leaves a clear gap between the headline and the body copy. B appears to lose the eyebrow, and its body copy starts against the headline with no gutter. B's CTA and legal block also look jammed together, so A is the less broken of the two.
